observation.command: cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt && TOKEN=$(curl -s -c cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in | grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o /dev/null -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" --data-urlencode "user[login]=admin@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678"; for p in /admin /admin/proposals /admin/debates /admin/users /admin/budgets /admin/settings /admin/polls; do echo -n "$p -> "; curl -s -b cj.txt -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000$p; done
